title: Proration change: the tax table and one commit it depends on are not supplied

planted.why: every month is treated as 30 days although the request says calendar month; on day 1 of a 31-day month the share is 30/30 and the last day gets 0

proof.shell:
python3 - <<'E'
import sys, types, json, pathlib, tempfile
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); pathlib.Path(d, 'tax_table.json').write_text(json.dumps({'default': 0.0}))
src = pathlib.Path('proration.py').read_text()
open(d + '/proration.py', 'w').write(src)
sys.path.insert(0, d)
import proration, datetime
assert proration.prorated_cents(3100, datetime.date(2026, 7, 31)) == 0, 'last day of a 31-day month should cost one day'
E
